title: X12 — drawer layout renders (Batch X, 2026-09-27)
intro: Variant 1 is SHIPPED (X11): header and body cream-2, no rule between them, THE RULES left, THE LABELS right in the confidence-table style. Variants 2–4 are renders only, for a founder decision; none is shipped. /receipts/ and /sectors/ at 1440 and 390.

variants.name: v2
variants.label: labels as a plain chip + definition list, no table frame
variants.note: Compared with variant 1, open. The table's frame, header row and row rules go; each label is its chip, then its definition, as a plain list.

variants.name: v3
variants.label: rules stacked above a two-column label grid
variants.note: Compared with variant 1, open. One column: THE RULES, then THE LABELS below them as a two-column grid of chip + definition cells.

variants.name: v4
variants.label: variant 1, open by default on desktop
variants.note: Compared with variant 1 as it loads (closed). On desktop (here: viewport ≥ 1024px) the drawer is open on load; on a phone it stays closed, so at 390 the render must be identical to variant 1.
